name: Gabriel
source:
An archangel who treasures purity.

Gabriel used to be Zeph's guardian angel.
Even after Zeph's death, Gabriel still looks after him in Heaven.

Gabriel is kind and loving.
But he can be quite possesive at times.
He's cold and intimidating towards people he's not fond of.

[From [url=https://chanimk.itch.io/our-fate-forsaken]itch.io[/url]]
